assessment.summary: The allocation result states existence and uniqueness of a full constrained maximizing portfolio via KKT/strict concavity. The certified targets only cover scalar clipping bounds, conditional interior stationarity with q!=0, a coordinate improvement identity, burden monotonicity and a witness. No certified target proves the global optimizer/existence/uniqueness or existence of the budget multiplier.

theorem coordinate_improvement_identity
    (b q x y : Real) :
    (b * x - q / 2 * x ^ 2) - (b * y - q / 2 * y ^ 2) =
      (x - y) * (b - q / 2 * (x + y))
